page.overview:
What is Bed?

A bed is a dyeable block that allows a player to sleep and to reset their spawn point to within a few blocks of the bed in the Overworld. If the bed is obstructed or removed, the player spawns at the default world spawning location.

;Igloo A red bed naturally generates in each igloo. ;Village Beds of various colors generate in village houses, depending on the specific structure and biome:

Beds can be mined with any tool, or without a tool.

A bed also drops itself as an item when pushed by a piston.

entity.short_description: The is a location and a part of the Bedroom in Five Nights at Freddy's 4. It is the place where Nightmare Freddy can attack the player if they don't chase away the three Freddles. It's also where Nightmare Fredbear and…
entity.description:
The is a location and a part of the Bedroom in Five Nights at Freddy's 4. It is the place where Nightmare Freddy can attack the player if they don't chase away the three Freddles. It's also where Nightmare Fredbear and Nightmare can appear. Nightmarionne appears here in the Halloween edition replacing Nightmare.

The room itself boasts the same light blue wallpaper design as the rest of the location. Directly above the bed, two pictures can be seen. To the right of the bed, a green and blue lamp can be seen, barely visible on a nightstand. The floor cannot be seen, but it is assumed that it has the same cerulean carpet as the rest of the location.

The bed itself appears to be a twin-sized bed. The blankets contain triangles of various colored patterns. There also appear to be two pillows, although they only appear under the covers. The headboard is composed of several wooden pillars, and a Freddy Fazbear plush can be seen sitting in the middle of the Bed.
